name: SQLite FTS5 + sqlite-vec
summary: A local hybrid search setup inside a single SQLite file: FTS5, SQLite's built-in full-text extension, handles keyword search with BM25 ranking, and sqlite-vec, a separate extension, adds vector search through vec0 virtual tables. Results from both can be fused in SQL. Suits local or embedded agents that want search without a server.
facts: FTS5 with built-in bm25(), unicode61/porter/trigram tokenizers
sqlite-vec vec0 tables: float, int8 and binary vectors
sqlite-vec brute-force KNN in stable releases; DiskANN, IVF and rescore in v0.1.10 alphas
SQLite: public domain; sqlite-vec: MIT or Apache-2.0
sqlite-vec: Python, Node.js, Ruby, Go, Rust, WASM
goodFor: Hybrid keyword plus vector search with no server
watchOut: sqlite-vec is pre-v1 and warns of breaking changes
ANN indexes are still alpha; stable search is brute force
Hybrid ranking must be written by hand in SQL
